tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground. Everything sits on it.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, the brief panel, list rows on hover.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inputs, the WIP lane track, code wells.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around cards. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons) and lane lines. 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and signal.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, labels, captions on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, links, selected lane. The Finishline blue.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand fills.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Finish-tape yellow. The Next action band and the active lane only. Never text.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text on signal fills, in both themes.

tokens.name: signal-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet signal ground: active status pill, highlighted row.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid with 2px offset. 3:1 on surface, surface-raised and signal.

tokens.name: status-idea
tokens.usage: Idea status text and glyph.

tokens.name: status-ready
tokens.usage: Ready status text and glyph.

tokens.name: status-active
tokens.usage: Active status text and glyph (on signal-tint).

tokens.name: status-paused
tokens.usage: Paused status text and glyph.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Shipped status, fresh staleness, done checklist items.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Stale staleness and caution copy.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Cold staleness, destructive actions, errors.

tokens.name: focus-on-signal
tokens.usage: Focus ring on signal fills (the Next action band). Ink on yellow, 11:1.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind the Park dialog.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Project name on the Resume screen. One per view.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: The Next action text in its band; screen titles.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Section headings: Now, Needs a decision, Up next.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Split times and counts: days since progress, 2/3 lanes, 4/6 criteria. Tabular figures.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Wire Supabase sign-in through the GitHub App.
styles.usage: Running text, form values, list cells.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Row titles, project names in lists, button labels.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels: section eyebrows, lane numbers, status pills.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: The agent handoff brief, commit SHAs, branch names.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label; pill inner padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside controls and between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding, label to field.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections inside a card; Next action band padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between screen sections; page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top of screen to first heading.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, lane markers, code wells.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, pills.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, the brief panel.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Park dialog and menus only. Cards use a line border, not a shadow.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press, focus.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Dialog open, checklist tick, lane fill. Zero under prefers-reduced-motion.
